author: Nerd of the Rings
description:
During San Diego Comic-Con, I had the pleasure of chatting with Mark Rosewater, head designer for Magic: the Gathering.  We talk about their brand new adventure in Middle-earth with The Hobbit as well as looking ahead in-universe with Reality Fracture!  We also chat about his new card game - Mood Swings!

Check out new and upcoming MTG products here: https://amzn.to/4gdWuzl

#magicthegathering #mtgxhobbit #mtgambassador
title: Talking Magic with Mark Rosewater: The Hobbit, Reality Fracture, plus Mood Swings!
